decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 22 November 2005, the erection of roof extensions including a hip to gable conversion measuring a projection of 3.8m, a height of 2.7m and a length of 8.2 metres, a rear roof dormer measuring a projection of 2.95m, a height of 2.7m and a width of 6.895m, and a detached outbuilding measuring a width of 9m, a length of 9m and a ridge height of 3.8m reducing to 2.5 metres at the eaves was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B, C and E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the total volume of the extensions to the roof do not exceed 50m3 and the detached outbuilding is more than 5 metres from the house and takes up less than 50 percent of the garden area.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of rear roof extention incorporating front roof lights, and erection of a single storey detached building for use as garage and leisure room to house.
